corrected: 6866: description 'Double-length UniBearing™ assembly with bearing pads that can move or be fixed; ...' -> 'Double Long UniBearing™ that can move or be fixed, with pads mounted using stainless steel flathead socket cap screws; ...' (removed wording not on the page)
remaining_doubts: Page 594 (7-40) is a Linear Bearing Brake Hole Specifications cross-reference table, not a product table; its twelve 15-series bearing numbers (6515, 6516, 6523, 6524, 6525, 6526, 6530, 6531, 6533, 6534, 6535, 6536) are kept as stub parts carrying only bearing family and brake hole locations, under the derived name 'Brake Ready Linear Bearing'. Their real product names and dimensions are on other catalog pages, so a cross-chunk merge should prefer those entries' name and description.

Pages 7-38 and 7-39 (double mount assemblies) and 7-37 (long single mount) print the first bullet as 'Comprised of short single mount UniBearing™ attached to a T-slot profile'; it is kept verbatim in features although it looks like copy carried over from 7-36.

Dimension letter meanings for the assemblies (A/B/C) differ between the single mount pages (A = 3.125” housing, C = depth with profile) and the double mount pages (A = height with profile, C = 4.750” housing); dimension_notes follow each page's drawing.
